preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Certify value equivalence separately from scheduling/completeness.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: Preview requests current targets and may coalesce work; export evaluates and retains the complete ordered frame set.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Require fixture parity with identical fonts and materialized media.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: Both consume Scene, but WASM and native use different host, font, filesystem, and media prepass environments.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Backend name alone is insufficient; compare exact-capability pixels.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: The browser Vello engine is asynchronous WebGPU while native export selects and drives a native renderer path.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Video parity requires source-time, CORS, decode, and overlay exclusions.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: Preview seeks HTML media and extracts data URIs or overlays; native render fetches to files and decodes before rendering.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Audio certification must compare clock mapping and encoded mix, not preview audibility.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: Preview anchors composition time to AudioContext and schedules ahead; export materializes audio for the encoder timeline.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Any Canvas-selected run is excluded from renderer equivalence certification.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: Canvas2D implements only a subset and may omit or simplify nodes/effects.

preview_export_parity.certification_impact: Temporal certification requires the export sequence, while preview is responsiveness evidence only.
preview_export_parity.known_difference: The Player can skip intermediate targets while catching up; export must emit every requested frame in order.
